name: Microbiology and Immunology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Priority application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; positions may fill before final deadline.

english.note: Central IELTS minimum has no subscore below 5; PTE Academic 55 with no subscore below 53. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; consult official policy and program-specific requirements.

documents: Official undergraduate and graduate transcripts; international NACES verification
requirements.note: BS/BA and GPA 3.0 required. One semester each introductory biology, organic chemistry, introductory calculus and biochemistry expected. TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo when applicable. A non-refundable application fee is required; amount not stated on opened central pages. Limited departmental fee waivers may be available case by case; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

funding.note: Program says all accepted students receive stipend, health care and full tuition/fee waiver. Published undated IPIBS stipend $33,000, increasing to $35,000 after candidacy, tuition waiver and health insurance. Fellowship selection and continued support depend on program conditions.
